# @arki/mail

> Typed mail for TypeScript: templates typed by any Standard Schema, transports that never throw or invent ids, quota-aware failover that never sends twice after a timeout, and mail queued in the caller's transaction on `@arki/journal`.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/mail`: `MAIL_ERROR_CODES`, `MailError`, `MailExpired`, `MailInvalidInput`, `MailQuotaExhausted`, `MailRejected`, `MailUncertain`, `defineTemplate`, `failover`, `inMemoryQuotaStore`, `isMailError`, `kvQuotaStore`; and 24 more.
- `@arki/mail/templates/auth`: Mails for sign-in flows: magic link, email verification, password reset, sign-in code. `magicLink`, `resetPassword`, `signInCode`, `verifyEmail`; types `AuthLinkData`, `AuthLinkInput`, `SignInCodeInput`.
- `@arki/mail/http/resend`: Resend over its REST API with plain `fetch` (no SDK). `resend`; types `ResendOptions`.
- `@arki/mail/http/mailpit`: Mailpit over its HTTP JSON API with plain `fetch`. `mailpit`; types `MailpitOptions`.
- `@arki/mail/http/unosend`: Unosend over its REST API with plain `fetch`. `unosend`; types `UnosendOptions`.
- `@arki/mail/http/cloudflare`: Cloudflare Email Service (Email Sending REST API) with plain `fetch`. `cloudflare`; types `CloudflareOptions`.
- `@arki/mail/node/ses`: Amazon SES (v2 API) through `@aws-sdk/client-sesv2`, an optional peer loaded on the first send. `ses`; types `SesOptions`.
- `@arki/mail/react`: Renders a React Email component to the HTML and plain-text parts of a mail. `renderReact`.
- `@arki/mail/react/templates/magic-link`: `MagicLinkEmail`, `default`.
- `@arki/mail/react/templates/magic-link-minimal`: `MinimalMagicLinkEmail`, `default`.
- `@arki/mail/pg`: Mail that commits with the business write. `MAIL_JOB`, `mailOutbox`; types `EnqueueOptions`, `MailOutbox`, `MailOutboxOptions`, `MailTx`.
- `@arki/mail/pg/testing`: Assertions on queued mail, for tests. `mailQueueAssertions`; types `QueuedMail`.
- `@arki/mail/dot`: @arki/mail in a Dot app. `mail`.
- `@arki/mail/outbox`: Queued mail in a Dot app. `mailJobs`, `mailOutboxPlugin`; types `MailOutboxPluginOptions`.
- `@arki/mail/testing`: Test helpers. `mailSink`, `transportContract`; types `MailSink`, `SentRecord`, `TransportHarness`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- `send` returns the `SentMail` or a failure value; it does not throw for a mail that was not sent. Check with `isFailure` from `@arki/failure`.
- `text` is required on every template.
- When every transport is over quota, nothing is sent (`MailQuotaExhausted`). Add a transport without a quota for an unlimited fallback.
- `failover` never tries a second provider after a timeout (`MailUncertain`). The journal retries later instead.
- `mailOutbox.enqueue` needs a transaction (`E009` for the root db) and exactly one `to` recipient.
- A message id may be `null`. Never use it as a key without checking.
